train.title: By train
body: Amtrak and NJ Transit both stop at Trenton, about 35 minutes from the venue by car; Philadelphia's 30th Street Station is a 30-minute drive the other way.
The River Line light rail runs from Trenton and Camden to Cinnaminson station, a five-minute cab ride from The Merion.

air.title: By air
body: Fly into Philadelphia International (PHL) — the venue is about 25 minutes by car, and a taxi or rideshare from the terminal is the easiest way.
Newark (EWR) works too at about an hour and a half by car, or by train to Trenton.

ceremony.title: The wedding ceremony
body: A Bengali Hindu wedding is held under a mandap, a canopy on four pillars, before a sacred fire. It opens with the shubho drishti — the bride is carried in seated on a piri and circled seven times round the groom (the saat paak) before the two see each other, eyes meeting for the first time as the conch shells sound.

Then the mala badal, the exchange of garlands; the sampradan, the giving of the bride's hand; the saptapadi, seven steps round the fire, each a vow; and the sindoor daan, the vermilion in the parting of her hair that seals the marriage.
ceremony.dress: Traditional — saris, panjabis, lots of colour

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.body: Luchi, aloor dom and a great deal of cha to set you up for the day.

baraat.title: The baraat
baraat.body: The groom's procession arrives with the dhol; everyone on the groom's side, join in — everyone on the bride's side, come out to meet it.

vows.title: The ceremony
vows.body: Shubho drishti, the seven rounds and the seven steps. Please be seated by a quarter to twelve.

cocktails.title: Cocktail hour
cocktails.body: Drinks and small plates while the ballroom is turned around.

reception.title: Reception
